captions_note: the dots stand in for the counted words: fx_add.py hides the reel's captions only while they are up (work/reel_captions.json)
in_a_reel: a later slot of the same effect (fx_new.py --name) can show progress: COUNT = all, FILLED = steps done

the buyer's style wins: set the STYLE block at the top of build.py to the reel's caption style (font, weight, tracking, case, ink, accent) before the first build (effects/INDEX.md, Restyling an effect's own words)
steps: run build.py SAFE=1      # prints count, timing, the snapshot times and the caption window
run check.py      # frame count, work/check/sheet.jpg, phone copy
